title: NestJS
label: NestJS
desc: Progressive Node.js framework with modules, decorators, and dependency injection.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Scaffold a NestJS project and configure the application bootstrap.

snippets.code:
# Create a project with the official CLI
npx @nestjs/cli@latest new users-api --package-manager npm

cd users-api

# Start with hot reload on port 3000
npm run start:dev

# Default scripts created by the CLI
npm run start        # Run once, no watch mode
npm run start:dev    # Watch mode with hot reload
npm run start:prod   # Run the compiled output in dist/
npm run build        # Compile with the Nest CLI
npm run test         # Run Jest unit tests
npm run test:e2e     # Run the e2e suite in test/

sections.title: CLI
sections.description: Generate building blocks and run the project from the terminal.

snippets.code:
# Generators, also available as nest g
nest generate module users
nest generate controller users --no-spec
nest generate service users
nest generate resource orders      # Module, controller, service, DTOs, entity
nest generate guard auth
nest generate interceptor logging
nest generate filter http-exception
nest generate pipe parse-date
nest generate middleware request-id

# Compile TypeScript into dist/
nest build

# Run from source and reload on changes
nest start --watch

# Attach the Node inspector on port 9229
nest start --debug --watch

# Print Node, npm, and Nest package versions
nest info

sections.title: Prisma Integration
sections.description: Wire Prisma Client into the Nest lifecycle and query the database from services.

snippets.code:
# Install the runtime and the CLI
npm install @prisma/client
npm install --save-dev prisma

# Create prisma/schema.prisma for PostgreSQL
npx prisma init --datasource-provider postgresql

# Create the first migration and regenerate the client
npx prisma migrate dev --name init

# Regenerate after editing the schema
npx prisma generate
